name: Data Center Operation Technician
summary:
Data Center Operation Technician is a virtual reality training application developed as an integral part of the ImmerseLearn Data Center Operation Technician Certification Program.
The application provides students with an immersive, interactive learning environment where they can gain practical, hands-on experience with data center operations through realistic VR simulations.
